adjudication.rationale: In sync mode (`APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT`), `parseRefreshTokenResponse` uses `minimumTokenResponseSchema.safeParse(response)` (packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts). `z.object(...)` strips unknown keys by default (no `.passthrough()`), so fields like `refresh_token`, `expiry_date`, `instance_url`, etc. are removed from the parsed `.data`. The function then forcibly sets `refresh_token` to the literal string "refresh_token" when missing, which will overwrite existing stored refresh tokens in callers that merge/spread parsed data (e.g., Office365: `o365AuthCredentials = { ...o365AuthCredentials, ...(tokenResponse.success && tokenResponse.data) }`), and can also drop other required fields (e.g., Salesforce update omits `instance_url`). This can break integrations on the next refresh once the real refresh token or other required fields are lost.
